messages.pages.blog.risk_management_trading.profi: Profit factor is gross profit divided by gross loss. A profit factor above 1.5 indicates a profitable strategy.

messages.pages.blog.what_is_a_trading_journal.a.t: A trading journal makes your behavior visible. Most traders remember the result of a trade, but forget the context: why they entered, whether the trade followed the plan, how they managed risk, and what emotions influenced the decision. A journal captures these details so they can be reviewed later.
messages.pages.blog.what_is_a_trading_journal.wha: What does a trading journal actually do?
What Is a Trading Journal and Why Does Every Trader Need One?
messages.pages.blog.what_is_trading_journal.a.jou: A journal also helps identify destructive patterns such as overtrading, revenge trading and rule violations. Many traders without a journal never discover that 80% of their losses come from 20% of their bad trades.
messages.pages.blog.what_is_trading_journal.a.sma: A smart journal such as VELORA automatically structures data, calculates advanced metrics, identifies behavioural patterns with AI and makes review faster and more accurate.
messages.pages.blog.what_is_trading_journal.if.yo: If you record only profit and loss, your journal is closer to an account statement than a growth tool. Qualitative details such as emotions, entry rationale and lessons learned make a journal powerful.
messages.pages.blog.what_is_trading_journal.key.p: Key point: every trade should include at least 15 data fields. Recording fewer fields does not provide enough data for analysis.
messages.pages.blog.what_is_trading_journal.the.m: The main difference between successful and unsuccessful traders is often not talent, but the ability to learn from mistakes. A journal makes that learning systematic.
messages.pages.blog.why.traders.need.a.journal.th: Why Traders Need a Journal: The Mistakes You Cannot Fix Without Data
messages.pages.blog.why_traders_need_a_journal.af: After a few days, the details of a trade fade away. You may remember the profit or loss, but not the reason for entry, the emotional state, the market context, or the rule you broke. A journal preserves those details.
messages.pages.blog.why_traders_need_a_journal.ma: Many traders spend years without a journal, repeating the same mistakes. This article explains why journaling is essential.
messages.pages.blog.why_traders_need_a_journal.re: Revenge trading, hesitation, fear of missing out, and overtrading often appear as repeated patterns. Once they are recorded, they become easier to recognize and correct.
messages.pages.blog.why_traders_need_a_journal.sh: Should I review my journal weekly?
messages.pages.blog.why_traders_need_a_journal.so: Sometimes the strategy is not the issue. The execution is. A journal helps separate a weak setup from a good setup that was managed poorly.
messages.pages.blog.why_traders_need_a_journal.wh: Why Traders Need a Journal: The Mistakes You Cannot Fix Without Data | VELORA
messages.pages.blog.why_traders_need_a_journal.ye: Yes. Daily recording and weekly review is a practical rhythm for most traders.
messages.pages.blog.why_traders_need_journal.mist: Mistake three: breaking your plan. A positive result after breaking your own rules can make those rules seem unimportant, but a journal shows that rule violations lose money over time.
Mistake two: overtrading. Without recording your daily trade count, you may not notice that you trade too much. A journal shows exactly how many trades you take each day.
messages.pages.blog.why_traders_need_journal.stud: Studies show that after two years, 80% of traders without a journal still follow their original behavioural patterns. That means no meaningful progress has occurred.
The hard truth: 90% of traders without a journal lose their capital in the first two years. Journalling can substantially improve those odds.
Why Do Traders Need a Trading Journal? Common Mistakes Without One | VELORA

messages.pages.privacy.p05.title: Privacy — VELORA
messages.pages.privacy.p05.hero_intro: We built VELORA for traders who expect their financial and performance information to be managed with care, transparency and complete respect.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.security_body: Technical controls and restricted access are part of the product architecture, not an optional extra.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.transparency_body: We explain exactly what data is collected, why it is needed and when it is deleted.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.control_body: You have a clear, responsive route to access, correct or delete your data.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.document_intro: This document explains how VELORA handles data when you use its website, trading journal and analytical features. By using the services, you acknowledge that you have read and accepted this policy.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.scope_body: VELORA is a trading journal and trader-performance analysis tool. We process only the data needed to provide, secure and reasonably improve the services. VELORA is not a financial adviser and does not use your data to make or execute trades.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.collection_body: The data involved depends on the features you choose. For example, connecting a trading account or recording a trade provides VELORA with information related to that feature.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.account_info_body: Name, email, language settings and the identifiers needed to manage your account.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.trading_data_body: Journal records, performance statistics, notes and data that you enter or synchronise.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.technical_info_body: Browser type, security logs, IP address and data needed to diagnose faults and prevent abuse.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.support_comms_body: Requests, feedback and correspondence you send when contacting our team.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.use_1: To provide and personalise journal, reporting and performance-analysis features.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.use_2: To protect accounts, identify suspicious activity and maintain service reliability.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.use_3: To respond to support requests and communicate important service changes.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.use_4: To improve the product using aggregated patterns that are non-attributable wherever possible.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.sharing_title: Your data is not for sale.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.sharing_body: We do not sell your personal data or trading-performance information, nor provide it to brokers for marketing. We may share only the minimum necessary data with service providers bound by confidentiality in the following circumstances:
messages.pages.privacy.p05.sharing_1: Hosting infrastructure, email delivery and technical support needed to operate the service.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.sharing_2: When required by valid law or a court order.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.sharing_3: To protect the rights and safety of users, VELORA or the public against fraud and abuse.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.security_detail: We use established technical and organisational safeguards, including restricted access, secure data transmission and security-event monitoring. No digital transmission or storage method is absolutely guaranteed, so we recommend using a unique password and appropriate authentication.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.retention_detail: We retain data only as long as necessary to provide services, meet legal obligations, resolve disputes or enforce agreements. We then delete or anonymise it.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.rights_body: Subject to applicable law, you may request access to or correction of your personal data, obtain a copy, restrict processing or delete your account. To protect security, we may verify your identity before fulfilling a request.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.changes_body: We may update this policy to reflect changes to the product, legal requirements or security practices. For material changes, we will publish the new version on this page and, where appropriate, notify you by email or in-product notice. Continued use after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated version.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.contact_title: Have a privacy question or request?
messages.pages.privacy.p05.contact_body: If you have questions about this policy or how your data is processed, the VELORA privacy team is ready to help. We normally review requests as quickly as possible.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.cta_body: Contact the privacy team to request access to, correction of or deletion of personal data.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.footer_note: A focused space to record, analyse and improve trading performance, with privacy at the heart of the product experience.
messages.pages.privacy.p05.footer_tagline: Privacy that is transparent and controllable
